m: अर्घ् cl. 1. P. अर्घति, to be worth, be of value, Pañcat.; (cf. √ अर्ह्)
a: अर्घ् — {c1c} P. [अर्घति, अर्घितुं, अर्घित] To be worth, have value, to cost; परीक्षका यत्र न संति देशे नार्घंति रत्नानि समुद्रजानि Subhāṣ.

m: अर्घापचय m. ‘diminution of price’
अर्घापच˚येन ind. instr. cheaper, Gaut.
अर्घार्ह mfn. worthy of or requiring a respectful offering, a superior.

s: puM, (arGo'styasya iti arGI, tezu ISaH .) SivaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
v: pu॰ arGo'styasya ini deyatvena tezu ISaH । sarvvadevezu pUjyatame mahAdeve ।
m: अर्घीश m. (‘अर्घिन्’ for अर्घ) = अर्घेश्वर, q.v., L.

s: mUlye, (BvAdi -- paraM -- sakaM sew .) iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ arGati gAM gopaH । iti durgAdAsaH । (“parIkzakA yatra na santi deSe nArGanti ratnAni samudrajAni” । iti paYcatantre .)

puM, (arGa + GaY .) mUlyaM । (“kuryyurarGaM yaTApaRyaM tato viMSaM nfpo haret” । “maRimuktAprabAlAnAM lOhAnAM tAntavasya ca । ganDAnAYca rasAnAYca vidyAdarGabalAbalam” ॥ iti manuH .) pUjAviDiH । ityamaraH ॥ ayaM SabdaH sAmagAnAM sarvvatrABilApe sayakAro napuMsakaliNgenEva prayojyaH anyavedinAM niryakAraH puMliNgena prayojyaH । iti SrAdDatattvaM ॥ (dUrvvAkzatasarzapapuzpAdiviracitodevabrAhmaRAdisammAnArTaH pUjopacAraBedaH । “aye vanadevateyaM PalakusumapallavArGeRa mAmupatizWate” । iti uttaracarite । “sa pratyagrEH kuwajakusuBEH kalpitArGAya tasmE” । iti meGawUte । “wUrvvAsarzapapuzpARAM datvAGaM pUrRamaYjalim” । iti yAjYavalkyaH .)
v: mUlye BvAdi॰ para॰ saka॰ sew । arGati ArGIt । AnarGa । arGaH । arGyaH ।

pu॰ arGa--GaY । kreyavastugrahaRAryaM deye tulyarUpe rajatAdidravyarUpe 1 mUlye । “kurbDIrta cEzAM pratyakzamarDa saMsTApanaM nfpaH” “kuryyurarGaM yaTApaRyamiti” ca manuH arha--karaRe GaY nyaNkvAditvAt kutvam । 2 pUjopacAre dUrvvAkzatAdO । sAmagErayaM sayakAraH klIvaliNgaSca prayoktavyaH anyEH puMliNgoniryakAraSca । aGAya deyam yat । arGyam pUjArTe deve jalAdo arGadravyARi ca “ApaH kzIraM kuSAgraYca daDi sarpiH sataRqulam । yavaH sidDArTakaScEva azwANgo'rGaH prakIrttitaH” kASIKaRqam । “tamarvyamarvyAdikayAdipUrUzaH” mAGaH “arGyamarGyamiti vAdinaM nfpaM so'navekzya BaratAgrajo yataH” “arGAnupadamASizamiti” ca raGuH ।
m: अर्घ m. (√ अर्ह्), worth, value, price, Mn. Yājñ.
(often ifc. cf. धनार्घ, महार्घ, शतार्घ, सहस्रार्घ)
respectful reception of a guest (by the offering of rice, durva-grass, flowers, or often only of water), ŚBr. xiv, &c. (often confounded with अर्घ्य, q.v.)
a collection of twenty pearls (having the weight of a Dharaṇa), VarBṛS.
a: अर्घः — [अर्घ्-घञ्] 1 Price, value; कुर्युरर्घं यथापण्यं Ms. 8. 398; Y. 2. 251; कुत्स्याः स्युः कुपरीक्षका हि मणयो यैरर्घतः पातिताः Bh. 2. 15 reduced in their true value, depreciated; so अनर्घ priceless; महार्घ very costly. --2 A material of worship, respectful offering or oblation to gods or venerable men, consisting of rice, Dūrvā grass &c. with or without water; दूर्वासर्षपपुष्पाणां दत्त्वार्घं पूर्णमंजलिं Y. 1. 290; कुटजकुसुमैः कल्पितार्घाय तस्मै Me. 4; the ingredients of this offering are: -आपः क्षीरं कुशाग्रं च दधि सर्पिः सतंडुलम् . यवः सिद्धार्थकश्चैव अष्टांगोऽर्घः प्रकीर्तितः .. see अर्घ्य below. --Comp. --अर्ह a. worthy of a respectful offering. --दानं presentation of a respectful offering. --बलाबलं rate of price, proper price, the cheapness or dearness of articles, fall or rise in prices; Ms. 9. 329. --संख्यानं, संस्थापनं the price of commodities, appraising, assizes of goods; कुर्वीत चैषां (वणिजां) प्रत्यक्षमर्घसंस्थापनं नृपः Ms. 8. 402.

k.v: परिघः परिघातेऽस्त्रेऽप्योघो वृन्देऽम्भसां रये। मूल्ये पूजाविधावर्घोऽहोदुःखव्यसनेष्वघम्.।
परिघः परिघातेऽस्त्रेऽप्योघो वृन्देऽम्भसां रये। मूल्ये पूजाविधावर्घोऽहोदुःखव्यसनेष्वघम्.।

m: अर्घ—बलाबल n. rate of price, proper price, the cheapness or dearness of commodities, Mn. ix, 329 (cf. अर्घस्य ह्रासं वृद्धिं व, Yājñ. ii, 249). =
अर्घ—दान n. presentation of a respectful offering.
अर्घ—पात्र n. (for अर्घ्य-पात्र) the small vessel in which water is offered to the guest on his arrival, Kathās.

अर्घ—संस्थापन n. fixing the price of commodities, appraising, assize (it is the act of a king or ruler, in concert with the traders, and should be done once a week or once a fortnight), Mn. viii, 402.
अर्घट n. (= पार्घट, q.v.) ashes, L.
अर्घेश्वर m. N. of Śiva, (cf. अर्घीश)
अर्घ्यार्ह m. the plant Pterospermum Suberifolium, L.

s: tri, (arhyate pUjyate, arha + Ryat, nyaNkvAdInAYceti kutvaM, arGamarhati iti pAdArGAByAYceti yat vA .) pUjanayogyaM । pUjyaM । iti medinI ॥ arGyArTaM । tattu pUjArTadUrvvAkzatacandanapuzpamiSritavAri । ityamaraH ॥ (“anarGyamarGyeRa tamadrinATaH, svargOkasAmarccitamarccayitvA” । iti kumArasamBave । “arGyamarGyamitivAdinaM nfpaM, so'navekzya BaratAgrajo yataH” । iti raGuvaMSe .) arGArTajalam iti amarawIkAyAM BarataH ॥ tattu sAmAnyaviSezaBedena dviviDaM । tatrAdyasya kramaH । svavAme trikoRavfttaBUvimbaM viliKyADAraSaktiM pUjayitvA astramantreRa pAtraM prakzAlya mantreRa jalenApUryyANkuSamudrayA mantreRa, sUryyamaRqalAttIrTamAvAhya praRavena ganDapuzpAByAM saMpUjya DenumudrAM pradarSya praRavamazwaDA daSaDA vA japet ॥ antyasya kramaH । svavAme trikoRamaRqalaM kftvA tatra tripadikAmAropya astreRa SaNKaM prakzAlya tadupari saMsTApya mantreRa ganDapuzpAkzatadUrvvAdi tatra niHkzipya vimalajalena vilomamAtfkayA mUlena ca pUrayet tatastripadikAyAM vahnimaRqalapUjA SaNKe sUryyamaRqalapUjA jale somamaRqalapUjA tato mantreRANguSamudrayA sUryyamaRqalAttIrTamAvAhya mantreRa svahfdayAddevatAM tatrAvAhya kUrccamantreRAvaguRWyAstramantreRa gAlinImudrAM pradarSya mantreRa tajjalaM vIkzya aNgamantrEH sakalIkftya ganDapuzpAByAM devatAM saMpUjya tadupari matsyamudrayAcCAdya mUlamantramazwaDA japtvA DenumudrAM pradarSyAstreRa saMrakzya tasmAt kiYcit jalaM prokzaRIpAtre niHkzipet । iti tantrasAraH ॥
klI, (arGa + yat .) jaratkArumunitapovanatarUdBatamaDu । tasya guRAH । cakzurAyurhitakAritvaM । AmavAtakaPapittanASitvaYca । iti rAjavallaBaH ॥
v: tri॰ arhyate pUjyate arha--Ryat--nyaNkA॰ kutvamarGamarhati arGa + yat vA । 1 pUjanIye “tamarGyamarGyAdika yAdipUruzaH mAGaH” । arGAya deyaM yat । 2 pUjArTaM deye jalAdO । “tAnarGyAnarGyamAdAya dUrAt pratyudyayO giriH” kumA॰ । “anarGyamarGyeRa tamadrinATaH” kumA॰ । arGaM mUlyamaDikamarhati yat । 3 jarutkAratapovanavfkzodBave maDuni na॰ tasya bahumUlyatvAttaTAtvam ।
m: अर्घ्य mfn. ‘valuable’, see अन्-अर्घ्य, (g. दण्डादि, q.v., ‘अर्घम्-अर्हति’) deserving a respectful reception (as a guest), PārGṛ.; Yājñ. &c.
belonging to or used at the respectful reception of a guest, Gobh.; Yājñ. &c.
अर्घ्य n. (Pāṇ. v, 4, 25) water offered at the respectful reception of a guest, ĀśvGṛ. &c., (probably for आर्घ्य, q.v.) a kind of honey, L.
a: अर्घ्य — a. [अर्घ-यत् अर्घमर्हति] 1 Valuable; अनर्घ्य invaluable; see s. v. --2 Venerable, deserving respectful offering; तानर्घ्यानर्घ्यमादाय दूरात्प्रत्युद्ययौ गिरिः Ku. 6. 50; Śi. 1. 14; Y. 1. 110. --र्घ्यं 1 A respectful offering or oblation to a god or venerable person (see अर्घ); अर्घः पूजाविधिः तदर्थं द्रव्यं अर्घ्यं Sk.; अर्घ्यमस्मै V. 5.; ददतु तरवः पुष्पैरर्घ्यं फलैश्च मधुश्चुतः U. 3. 24; अर्घ्यमर्घ्यमिति वादिनं नृपं R. 11. 69; 1. 44; Ku. 1. 58, 6. 50; (it often consists only of water given in a droṇa and forms part of the Madhuparka ceremony). --2 A kind of honey.

k.v: षट्तु त्रिष्वर्घ्यमर्घार्थे पाद्यं पादाय वारिणि। क्रमादातिथ्यातिथेये अतिथ्यर्थेऽत्र साधुनि॥

m: अर्घ्य—शील mfn. of deferential character or disposition, R.
अर्घ्य—दान n. a partic. act of homage to the sun, RTL. 407
अर्घ्य—पात्र n. See अर्घ-प्˚.
